title: Variance from nonzero Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the binary cube $( br/2 br)^n$. The variance of $f$ under the uniform distribution on this cube equals the sum of the squares of its vector Fourier coefficients over all nonzero vectors.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the binary cube of dimension $n$
